After Dark: The Art of Outdoor Living with Centurion Lighting

  • Jody Robinson
  • July 26, 2026
  • Business Showcase

By Jody Robinson

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 2:56
Instaread

As the sun sets over Orange County, a beautifully illuminated home takes on an entirely new personality. Pathways glow with warmth, architectural details emerge from the shadows, and gardens become dramatic outdoor retreats. Great landscape lighting isn’t simply about visibility—it’s about creating an experience.

For more than three decades, Centurion Lighting has been helping Southern California homeowners bring that vision to life. Based locally, the company manufactures premium architectural lighting that is proudly made in the USA, with fixtures cast in solid brass and copper and engineered to withstand the elements while delivering timeless beauty. Its products are especially well suited for coastal communities, where quality craftsmanship and durable materials make all the difference.

A Legacy of Quality and Craftsmanship

Centurion’s story is woven into the growth of Orange County itself. From the early days of Ladera Ranch to luxury homes throughout Newport Coast and Laguna Beach, the company has partnered on countless residential and commercial projects. Its custom lighting can also be found at iconic destinations including Montage, Pendry and Disneyland, showcasing the versatility and craftsmanship behind every fixture.

“Our philosophy has always been simple—listen to the customer first,” says Sales Representative Adam Jastrow. “We started in the pool and landscape industry in the mid-’90s, and by understanding what homeowners and contractors needed, we developed products that combine exceptional durability with beautiful design.”

That commitment extends well beyond manufacturing. Centurion’s lighting designers work closely with architects, landscape professionals and homeowners to create customized lighting plans that enhance each property’s unique character. One of the company’s most valuable services is its nighttime demonstration, allowing clients to experience different lighting techniques before installation.

“Seeing your home professionally lit at night before making a final decision is a game changer,” Jastrow says. “Together, we fine-tune every fixture, every beam angle and every focal point until the design feels just right.”

Designed to Last for Generations

The results are both beautiful and practical. Professionally designed landscape lighting improves safety by illuminating walkways and entryways, enhances security, extends the enjoyment of outdoor living spaces well into the evening and creates unforgettable curb appeal that can increase a home’s value.

Quality remains at the heart of every Centurion product. Each fixture is engineered to stand up to years of sun, salt air and the elements without sacrificing performance or appearance. Because the company has such confidence in its American-made craftsmanship, every fixture is backed by a lifetime guarantee, along with a 10-year warranty on its Forever Bright LED lamp source—a reflection of more than 30 years of manufacturing excellence.

“When homeowners invest in outdoor lighting, they’re investing in how they experience their home every evening,” says Jastrow. “Our goal is to create something they’ll enjoy for decades.”

Because as the sun sets, the right lighting doesn’t just illuminate a home. It creates an atmosphere, showcases exceptional architecture and transforms an ordinary evening into something extraordinary.
